propositions: Bug provenance is captured at creation and queryable via bug_trends metrics lens without requiring new user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates enforce raw-git-write blocking, unread config field detection, wall-clock assertion bounds, AC checkbox completeness, code-comment hygiene, and oversized unreviewed bug-fix prevention.
Reconciler transport is typed end-to-end with declared field asymmetries pinned by property tests and pagination deduplicated into shared iterators.
Production shell logic (reconcile-bridge/canary workflows, probe harness, vote normalizer) is migrated from shell to Python per strangler-fig policy.
Canary/automation bug filing follows hardened dedup pattern with documented bug-creation contract and fix-validated dedup-key normalization.

Epic completion attestation was missing due to stale-material reads post-330c checkbox normalization; remediated via grandfathering legacy attestations in compute_validity and re-running completion verifier.
